method.connectivity: DSU same-recipe unions of exported positive-length clipped world edges
method.vertices: ALL sites including geometric halo plus all adjacency endpoints; zero-pixel nodes retained
method.area: APPROXIMATION: winner raster pixel count * step^2; zero-pixel graph vertices retained
method.censoring: APPROXIMATION: any member cell sampled on a raster border; may miss subpixel boundary contacts
method.populations: area statistics, component counts and recipe occurrence use pixels>0 groups ONLY; haloOnly reports zero-pixel groups separately; CSV retains all groups; completeOnly means not flagged by approximate raster-border censoring, not proven geometrically complete
method.quantiles: component-unweighted NumPy linear percentiles; area-weighted inverse area ECDF
method.single600: exactly one graph cell; fractions by components, cells, and approximate area; B/C only
method.judgement: descriptive only; no parameter or area PASS thresholds
